name: Litchfield Park
seo_title: Litchfield Park Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 6 Events, 2 Free
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Litchfield Park, AZ: the city tree lighting, Hometown Parade, The Wigwam events, Breakfast with Santa and Las Posadas.
lede: Litchfield Park celebrates with a city tree lighting, a Christmas in the Park Hometown Parade and holiday evenings at The Wigwam resort.
celebrates: Litchfield Park is a small city with a big Christmas calendar. The City lights its tree at Litchfield Square Park with photos with Santa, carolers and sleigh rides, then hosts Christmas in the Park, a free family festival with a Hometown Parade, Santa's Workshop crafts, a petting zoo, inflatables and more than 60 vendors. The Wigwam resort lights its own tree on the front lawn, adds firepit s'mores evenings with a Winter Princess, and serves Breakfast with Santa at Litchfield's. Las Posadas, a traditional Christmas procession, is also part of the season.
lastyear: Last year, the City of Litchfield Park held Christmas in the Park on Saturday, December 13, 2025, from 9 am to 3 pm. The festival's hometown parade featured more than 75 entries, with Santa and Mrs. Claus riding Old Red, and a new parade route for 2025 that headed north on Old Litchfield Road. The city described the festival as a family focused event that is free and open to the public.
facts: Christmas in the Park is a family focused festival that the City of Litchfield Park says is free and open to the public. Its parade starts at 10 am at Old Litchfield Road and Villa Nueva Drive, according to a local newspaper report, and Santa and Mrs. Claus ride Old Red. The Wigwam resort sits on East Wigwam Boulevard, and its holiday programs include a tree lighting where a toy donation earns a free hot chocolate voucher.
trains: Litchfield Park has no holiday train of its own. The nearest free train rides are at Maricopa Live Steamers in Glendale, which runs Holiday Lights Train Rides on select evenings, and our Glendale page lists the dates. The Arizona Railway Museum in Chandler keeps historic railroad cars on display, and McCormick-Stillman Railroad Park in Scottsdale has model trains and a miniature railroad. Both are a drive from Litchfield Park.

faq: When is Christmas in Litchfield Park?

The City of Litchfield Park holds Christmas in the Park on the second Saturday of December, and its tree lighting is a week earlier. The Wigwam lights its own tree the day after Thanksgiving. Each event listing on this page gives the current year's date, hours and cost.
Is Christmas in the Park free?

Yes. The city describes Christmas in the Park as a family focused event that is free and open to the public. Vendor purchases, food and some extras cost money. The festival includes a parade, a holiday market, Santa's Workshop crafts, a petting zoo and inflatables.
Where can kids meet Santa in Litchfield Park?

Santa joins the city tree lighting for photos, rides in the Christmas in the Park parade with Mrs. Claus, arrives at The Wigwam tree lighting on a firetruck and visits Breakfast with Santa at Litchfield's. Photos at the festival run through the middle of the day.
What does Breakfast with Santa cost at The Wigwam?

Adults pay $45 and children ages 4 to 12 pay $25, while children 3 and under eat free. Reservations are required. Listings on this page give the dates and flag where the seating time comes from a third party listing, so confirm when you book.
Is there a train ride in Litchfield Park?

No. Maricopa Live Steamers in Glendale runs free Holiday Lights Train Rides on select evenings, which is the closest option. The Arizona Railway Museum in Chandler is a year round choice for families who love trains and want a longer drive.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Litchfield Park for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Annual Tree Lighting at The Wigwam) through December 20 (Breakfast with Santa at Litchfield's), with the City Tree Lighting Ceremony (December 4), the Christmas in the Park Hometown Parade (December 12) and A Winter Wonderland on three Fridays along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
